stories.text:
Thanks a lot for sharing your thoughts and teachings, I must say that from now on I will pay much more attention to what comes both from my mouth and my keyboard. Most of things I heard today were very inspiring, but I was so sad to listen about the Armageddon and destruction of our planet... very similar to what you can find in the New Testament.

May I ask a question again? Sorry for being a pest and asking questions and for not knowing how to address properly to a Rabbi, but I hope you forgive.

The thing is that I also listen a Jewish kabbalist, who happened to be a Chabadnik, too. If I understood well, regarding prophecies from Talmud and Torah, he sees them rather metaphorically than literally. The same goes for Armageddon, Maschiah and Messianic Era. According to him, Armageddon is almost over - and by destruction of the evil forces he means mostly destruction of, so called "deep state", but also a destruction of all people who did evil things, both to Jews and non-Jews.

And by Messianic Era he means the Era of all these new technologies, like internet as a global communication channel that allows even to us, non-Jews, to listen Jewish Rabbis like you - which has never be able before in history and was even unimaginable. Because there are people like me, who are willing to listen and learn and who are spiritual but are... kind of agnostics, can't find all answers in their own religions, have doubts and some of those doubts are in general about doctrines from various religions... So far I have learned something about Judaism directly from Jewish Rabbis who are talking to Jewish people, but the rest of us can listen, too, if we want. And I have also learned that even among the Jews there are differences in the way they preach Talmud and Torah.

Now I don't want to put in trouble nor you, neither this guy. I don't even want to compare you and say one is better then the other. I only wonder about this major discrepancy within Judaism. One is more optimistic, at least about the Armageddon thing.

Could you consider this point of view and make, at least, a 10% room of possibility that this may be direction in which things will unfold?

Or could even deaths, both from c0r0n4 and from c0r0n4 measures, or from mass v4ccin4ti0n, be a form of Armageddon (that is my own thought)? Because people are dying all around the world. And most of them are actually those who now can't cure their chronic diseases because all hospitals are in c0v1d mode. Now there are much bigger rates of heart attacks, strokes, cancer deaths, etc.

Sorry for a long message, and my English. Thanks if you read it.
